verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is mParticle's Data Privacy Controls, which apply consent-based forwarding rules (e.g., do not forward when a CCPA data-sale opt-out is present). That blocks whole data flows by consent state; it is not per-destination hashing, masking, or field-level filtering of sensitive attributes. The 'Transform data as it enters and leaves mParticle' and 'Consent Filters' items are titles only, with no content describing PII hashing, masking, or attribute filtering per destination.

support.subject: As a privacy lead, I can control PII flow per destination — hashing, masking, and field-level filtering of sensitive attributes

citations.quote: Applying a forwarding rule of: Do not forward if CCPA Data sale opt out is present.
